Mass Manager is an Experimental Effect for Frame Shift Drives that increases optimized mass while reducing FSD integrity.

{{#invoke:ExperimentalEffects|infobox|fsd_mass_manager}}

== What It Does ==
Mass Manager improves the drive parameter most directly associated with jump range. It is commonly considered on larger Frame Shift Drives when maximum range is the priority.
